lanes.title: Current Normal Chat Path
lanes.summary: The existing path routes normal text through the harness before deciding whether to answer, execute, show verified state, or ask guidance.

nodes.label: CLI Input
nodes.note: Receives user text and calls core.

nodes.label: Agent Loop
nodes.note: Coordinates route, tool loop, synthesis, and final events.

nodes.label: Route Decision
nodes.note: Interprets model route JSON and may trigger more provider calls.

nodes.label: Provider Request
nodes.note: Sends messages to LM Studio or another configured provider.

nodes.label: Displayed Answer
nodes.note: Stores provider, verified, or controller messages for display.

lanes.title: Proposed Simple Raw Path
lanes.summary: The baseline path we can add later: prompt in, provider text out, no harness decisions.

nodes.label: Raw CLI Input
nodes.note: Explicit command for direct model interaction.

nodes.label: Raw Chat
nodes.note: Would send only the user prompt to the provider.

nodes.label: Provider Request
nodes.note: Same provider client, but without tools or route prompts.

lanes.title: Bypassed In Raw Mode
lanes.summary: These layers stay available for agent work, but the raw path should not call them.

nodes.label: Tools
nodes.note: No tool definitions, tool calls, or tool result synthesis.

nodes.label: Permissions
nodes.note: No filesystem or shell action is proposed.

nodes.label: Plans And Memory
nodes.note: No verified plan, memory, or context injection.
